description:
FILED s474b (Fable, 2026-09-07) -- USER: "Sounds good".  Independent of #1061/#1502 (a filler for any free slot); its rows join #1502's row-level file once that exists (do not invent a second row format -- if #1502 has not landed, bless the per-FILE snapshot only and leave the rows to #1502).

WHAT: `cpan-tests/modules/` holds Test-Simple-1.302199, Text-CSV-2.04, YAML-Tiny-1.74 (unpacked, with tarballs) and `easy-targets/` (Basename.pm Carp.pm Exporter.pm Spec.pm).  s438 (#473) made its `t/**/*.t` files a DROP-CENSUS population (42 files / 83 drops then; PROGRAM mode, transpiled WITHOUT the dist's own lib -- measured identical), but nobody has ever run them as a scored board.  Test-Simple's suite is the largest single pure-Perl test corpus on disk (~360 files in the ~/.cpan/build copy) and it exercises Test2/Test::Builder -- the harness PCL's own TAP layer replaces (`use Test::More` resolves to cl/pcl-test.lisp), so expect a large "PCL substitutes its own Test::More" family: DECIDE FIRST, with the USER if needed, whether Test-Simple's own tests are a meaningful target at all (they test the module PCL replaces) or whether only Text-CSV + YAML-Tiny + easy-targets are scored; record the decision in DECIDED.

JOB: run `perl tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --jobs 8 --timeout 120 --tsv baselines/cpan-board-tree-sNNN.tsv cpan-tests/modules/<dists>` with real perl beside it (oracle rule 1), bless the snapshot with a header naming the perl-side skips, and give its FAIL/PARTIAL files the #1502 treatment (one cause per cluster, <= 1 h fixes ship).  #478 (`_extract_module_prototypes` skips every Test2::/Test:: module BY NAME, so `(&)` block-form calls in these files are silently mis-parsed) is the known blocker for Test-Simple's files -- measure how many rows sit behind it before deciding to fix it inside this task.

BARS: snapshot blessed with causes; STATUS.md's population table gains the row; drop census unchanged (or rows leave by edit with a fix); gate green.
subject: SCORE the second CPAN population, cpan-tests/modules/ (Test-Simple, Text-CSV, YAML-Tiny + easy-targets; ~308 t-files) with the scoreboard -- today it is a drop-census population only, never scored; the cheapest board widening because the files are already in the tree
